To find how many inches the crocodile will grow in 13 years, we first find the growth rate:

$$
\text{Growth rate} = \frac{8 \text{ inches}}{4 \text{ years}} = 2 \text{ inches per year}
$$

Now, multiply the growth rate by 13 years:

$$
2 \text{ inches per year} \times 13 \text{ years} = 26 \text{ inches}
$$

FINAL_ANSWER: 26
